correctness.rationale: The source's displayed decomposition can be checked term by term: its F_Ia contains alpha_y*I_y while V_Ia contains -alpha_y*I_y, so F-V contains two copies of the aging transfer although model (1) contains one; the same happens from adult to elder. Using only genuine new infections in F and all aging/progression in V gives the stated lower-block-triangular next-generation matrix. The identity det(I-B)=[(eta1-beta11)(eta3-beta22)-beta21(beta12+alpha_y)]/(eta1 eta3) matches the direct disease-free infected Jacobian exactly. The fully positive rational counterexample is exact: the corrected determinant is 396801/1000000>0, the printed determinant is -203199/1000000<0, and the direct youth-adult linearization has negative trace and positive determinant.

originality.rationale: The general rule that progression among infected compartments is not a new infection is established next-generation theory and is not claimed as new. The original content is the source-specific diagnosis that the 2020 three-age-class HIV paper's displayed F and V fail to reconstruct its own ODEs, the exact corrected next-generation matrix, and a positive-parameter threshold reversal showing that the printed R0>1 condition can coexist with a locally stable disease-free equilibrium. Targeted DOI/title, formula, aging-transfer, correction, and erratum searches did not locate a published repair.
residual_risks: An unindexed author correction could exist outside the searched records.
The finding does not recompute the source's complete fitted parameter study or sensitivity rankings.

Alternative reproduction-number conventions exist, but they do not resolve the displayed source decomposition because its F-V difference is not the original model and the exact counterexample shows the printed threshold is not invasion-equivalent.

value.rationale: The source uses its reproduction number as the threshold for uniform persistence and endemic-equilibrium existence and as the object of sensitivity analysis. The error is therefore structural rather than cosmetic. The exact witness shows a qualitative reversal: the source's printed R0 is greater than one while the actual disease-free equilibrium is locally asymptotically stable. A correct threshold is necessary before interpreting invasion or control sensitivity in this age-structured model.
